mechanism: the BAR domain protein bridging integrator 2 (BIN2) interacts with STIM1 and with the IP3 receptor in platelets; deleting platelet BIN2 reduces both store release and Ca2+ influx, through impaired IP3R function combined with defective STIM1-mediated SOC channel activation
sentence: Here, we identified the BAR domain superfamily member bridging integrator 2 (BIN2) as an interaction partner of STIM1 and IP3R in platelets.
justification: The publication behind the curator's BIN2 row, which recorded the co-immunoprecipitation with STIM1 and IP3R without a reference. BIN2 sits at the junction between store release and store-operated entry, and losing it protects mice from arterial thrombosis and stroke.

mechanism: PGRMC1 binds directly to the coiled-coil domain of STIM1 and promotes its conformational switch, increasing SOCE and NFAT activation; depleting it in breast cancer cells reduces EGF-induced SOCE and disrupts focal adhesion turnover
sentence: Here, we report that PGRMC1 promotes store-operated Ca2+ entry (SOCE) as a functional interactor of stromal interaction molecule 1 (STIM1).
justification: The publication behind the curator's PGRMC1 row: her note says PGRMC1 binds the coiled-coil domains and facilitates the conformational change of STIM1, and this is the paper that shows it.

mechanism: junctophilin 1 knockout myotubes show down-regulation of STIM1 and ORAI1 protein, a severe reduction in store-operated Ca2+ entry and a lower resting cytosolic Ca2+, attributed to physical alteration of the SR / T-tubule junction
sentence: JP1 KO myotubes show down-regulation of Orai1 and Stim1 proteins, suggesting that this pathway may be important in the control of resting Ca(2+) homeostasis.
justification: The publication behind the curator's JPH1 row, whose note only recorded a colocalisation. The junction builder again, this time in muscle: without junctophilin 1 the SR-T-tubule contact is altered and both partners fall.

mechanism: same knockout: ORAI1 protein is down-regulated along with STIM1, and the myotubes become refractory to the Ca2+ entry blocker BTP2
sentence: JP1 KO myotubes show down-regulation of Orai1 and Stim1 proteins, suggesting that this pathway may be important in the control of resting Ca(2+) homeostasis.
justification: The channel side of the junctophilin 1 phenotype.

mechanism: STIM1 binds TRPC1, TRPC4 and TRPC5 and thereby determines their function as store-operated channels; inhibiting STIM1 blocks receptor activation of TRPC5 but not its activation by La3+
sentence: Here, we report that STIM1 binds TRPC1, TRPC4 and TRPC5 and determines their function as SOCs.
justification: The publication behind the curator's TRPC4 and TRPC5 rows, and the paper that defines a store-operated channel as one STIM1 regulates.

mechanism: same binding panel: STIM1 binds TRPC1 directly, which is the opposite of the mesangial-cell result where STIM1 co-immunoprecipitated with TRPC4 and not TRPC1
sentence: Here, we report that STIM1 binds TRPC1, TRPC4 and TRPC5 and determines their function as SOCs.
justification: Recorded deliberately next to PMID 19307462, which says STIM1 binds TRPC4 but not TRPC1: the same question answered both ways in different cells.

mechanism: STIM1 does not bind TRPC3 or TRPC6 but regulates them indirectly, by making TRPC3 heteromultimerise with TRPC1 and TRPC6 with TRPC4
sentence: STIM1 does not bind TRPC3 and TRPC6, and regulates their function indirectly by mediating the heteromultimerization of TRPC3 with TRPC1 and TRPC6 with TRPC4.
justification: An indirect route into the map: STIM1 reaches TRPC3 and TRPC6 not by binding them but by pairing them with TRPC1 and TRPC4. The sentence is also the explicit negative against PMID 23068106, where the STIM1L splice variant does bind TRPC3 and TRPC6.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation in HEK293 cells expressing the endothelin type A receptor: STIM1L, the skeletal-muscle splice variant, binds ORAI1 and also TRPC3 and TRPC6 more abundantly than STIM1 does, and suppresses receptor-operated Ca2+ entry through them
sentence: Coimmunoprecipitation experiments have revealed that when compared with STIM1, STIM1L binds more abundantly to Orai1 and also to TRPC3 and TRPC6.
justification: The other side of the TRPC3/TRPC6 question: a binding where PMID 17486119 reports none. The difference may be the splice variant, which is why the mechanism names it.

mechanism: activating the lysosomal two-pore channel TPC2 with NAADP or TPC2-A1-N abrogates SOCE, enhances the slow Ca2+-dependent inactivation of STIM1-gated ORAI1 channels and disassembles STIM1 clusters; the effect survives truncation after the SOAR domain and is prevented by calmodulin inhibition or cytosolic Ca2+ chelation
sentence: We conclude that Ca2+ ions released by TPC2 channels on lysosomes regulate CaM-dependent STIM1 inactivation.
justification: The lysosome reaching the ER sensor: calcium released by a lysosomal channel shuts STIM1 down through calmodulin. It is also the second lysosomal entry point into this map, after the LDL/lysosome arm of the STING side.

mechanism: protein kinase C phosphorylates ORAI1 at N-terminal Ser-27 and Ser-30 and suppresses SOCE; PKC inhibitors and knockdown of PKCbeta both increase Ca2+ influx, and an ORAI1 S27A/S30A mutant raises SOCE and CRAC currents
sentence: We propose that PKC suppresses SOCE and CRAC channel function by phosphorylation of Orai1 at N-terminal serine residues Ser-27 and Ser-30.
justification: The publication behind the SIGNOR phosphorylation edge PRKCB -> ORAI1, with the residues and the functional sign. The isoform comes from the knockdown of PKCbeta, which is why the mechanism records it rather than the sentence.

mechanism: beta-glycerophosphate, mimicking the high phosphate of chronic kidney disease, raises NFAT5, SGK1, ORAI1/2/3 and STIM1/2 transcripts and SOCE in megakaryocytes; the same transcripts and NFAT5 and ORAI1 protein are higher in platelets from patients with impaired kidney function
sentence: In conclusion, phosphate-donor ss-glycerophosphate triggers a signaling cascade of NFAT5/SGK1/ORAI/STIM, thus up-regulating store-operated Ca2+-entry.
justification: A transcriptional route to the channel rather than a contact on it, and it lands on SGK1, which entered the map in the previous batch as a kinase acting on ORAI1. Here SGK1 is the middle of a cascade that starts with phosphate.

mechanism: in ORAI1-knockout MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells reconstituted with wild-type or mutant ORAI1, PTGS2 (COX-2) regulation requires ORAI1 pore function and STIM1 binding, with no store depletion
sentence: In the absence of calcium store depletion, ORAI1 regulated PTGS2 in MDA-MB-231 cells, and this was dependent on ORAI1 pore function and STIM1 binding.
justification: A transcriptional output of the channel at rest: the resting ORAI1 current, not a store-depletion signal, sets COX-2 expression, and it still needs STIM1 on the other side of the junction.

mechanism: thapsigargin-evoked SOCE raises IL6 transcription in MDA-MB-468 cells in an ORAI1-dependent way, requiring ORAI1 pore function and STIM1 binding, and accompanied by NFAT1 translocation
sentence: The activation of SOCE by thapsigargin resulted in ORAI1-dependent increases in IL6 transcription in MDA-MB-468 cells; this was also dependent on ORAI1 pore function and STIM1 binding and was associated with the translocation of NFAT1.
justification: The stimulated counterpart of the PTGS2 arm, and the one that goes through NFAT1: the same channel writes two different gene programmes depending on whether the stores are full.

mechanism: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of STIM1 in SH-SY5Y cells strongly reduces ITPR3 transcript and protein, lowering mitochondrial free Ca2+, oxygen consumption and ATP synthesis; ectopic ITPR3 normalises all of it
sentence: Thus, STIM1 deficiency leads to a strong reduction of ITPR3 transcript and ITPR3 protein levels, a consequent decrease of the mitochondria free Ca2+ concentration ([Ca2+]mit), reduction of mitochondrial oxygen consumption rate, and decrease in ATP synthesis rate.
justification: STIM1 controlling an IP3 receptor by expression rather than by contact, and the consequence is mitochondrial: a STIM1-ITPR3 axis that sets how much calcium reaches the mitochondria.

mechanism: proximity ligation assay in PC12 and guinea pig adrenal medullary cells: TRPC1 forms a heteromeric channel with TRPC4, but not with TRPC5, in a STIM1-dependent manner, and muscarinic stimulation inserts the heteromer into the plasma membrane, which requires full-length STIM1
sentence: Proximity ligation assay (PLA) revealed that when exogenously expressed in PC12 cells, TRPC1 forms a heteromeric channel with TRPC4, but not with TRPC5, in a STIM1-dependent manner.
justification: The TRPC1-TRPC4 pair that databases carry as an edge, here with its condition: the heteromer only forms when STIM1 is there, and it only reaches the membrane on muscarinic stimulation.
